title: Parametric hanger plate
prompt: Wall hanger plate, 4 mm thick on Z = 0, corner at the origin: a width × height rectangle (parameters width = 60 and height = 40) with two M4 clearance holes (4.5 mm) symmetric about the vertical centre line, spacing mm apart (parameter spacing = 40) and 10 mm below the top edge. Use a fully constrained sketch so the holes stay centred and 10 mm below the top when the plate is resized.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Two Ø4.5 holes 40 mm apart, centred, 10 mm below the top
width = 70, spacing = 30: holes at x = 20 and 50, still 10 mm below the top
height = 50 keeps the holes 10 mm below the (new) top
width = 70, spacing = 30: (2800 − 2·π·2.25²)·4 = 11072.77 mm³, both holes still through
height = 50: (3000 − 2·π·2.25²)·4 = 11872.77 mm³, both holes still through
